repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a 30-second sustained wait (`for: 30 SEC`). With the current 1000 ms wrapper period, the candidate fires after 30 iterations (30 seconds) starting from t=0. However, the first iteration at t=0 counts as tick 1, so the condition is met at t=29000 ms (29 seconds elapsed), causing an early action. The IR only acts at t=30000 ms. The fix requires switching to a 100 ms wrapper and adjusting the threshold to 101 ticks (30.1 seconds) to ensure the action occurs after the full 30 seconds have elapsed.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed `period` from 1000 to 100 and updated the threshold from 30 to 101. This aligns with the rule for `wait(C, for: D)` where threshold = D(ms)/100 + 1, ensuring the action fires exactly at the 30-second mark.
